kapak.alt: Test order in a CPA session

youtube.baslik: In play audiometry, why test just two frequencies first? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In conditioned play audiometry, or CPA, a child's attention span is limited, so the most valuable information comes first: one low and one high frequency, such as 500 and 2000 Hz, in each ear. That way, even if the session ends early, there is information about both ears; if time and attention allow, remaining frequencies such as 1000 and 4000 Hz are added.
